what: Plan adds three render-cache symlink tests but omits the in-tree file-symlink case that plan-review already covers at 561-573
scenario_or_breakage: Symlink files under render-cache are not listed by find -type f; without the tree-wide find -type l guard publish can succeed while design_publish_stage_file silently skips symlinks (210-212). No harness asserts that regression
